answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farming. Each agent locks a 10-token bond losing 5% per epoch without verified work, so an idle fake slides to its nadir and loses its slot. Keeping 1,000 fakes alive costs 10,000 plus 500 decay per epoch, far more than fakes earn. Honest agents pay once, renew by working, and keep the network a haven for real contributors, while a bond surviving 20 epochs becomes a relic of proven history, renewed cheaper.
